products.name: PyTorch
products.note: Deep learning framework; model checkpoint governance; TorchServe deployment; research-to-production lineage

profile_text.body:
PyTorch.org is the home of the PyTorch Foundation, which describes itself as the deep learning community home for the open source PyTorch framework and ecosystem. The foundation operates under the Linux Foundation and is associated with Meta. PyTorch is an open source deep learning framework used across research and production workflows, with capabilities spanning model checkpoint governance, deployment via TorchServe, and research-to-production lineage.

The site also presents Captum, described as an open source, extensible library for model interpretability built on PyTorch. The name Captum derives from the Latin word for "comprehension." Together, PyTorch and Captum represent the foundation's core offerings in the open source and self-hosted model space.

The held facts record no litigation or MCP server presence associated with this entry. PyTorch is catalogued as an open source and self-hosted model product, with its governance and ecosystem stewardship shared between Meta and the Linux Foundation.
